title: Suitability Model
description: PROPOSED SuitabilityModel schema. It declares only the optional model_card_ref that tools/validators/domains/habitat/validate_suitability_model.py already enforces; that validator additionally requires the referenced file to pass ModelCardEnvelope validation. Identity, model-versus-observed source role, uncertainty, evidence, and release fields remain for the owning domain steward to define (see contracts/domains/habitat/suitability_model.md), so other members stay open.

model_card_ref.description: Optional repository-root-relative or absolute path to a ModelCardEnvelope JSON document.
